purpose: Teach: ハイブリッド/ハンセン病/要塞/点字/沸騰/磁石/ワイヤー/リフト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハイブリッド車のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was talking about hybrid cars.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Gentle delivery—noticing something small and worth sharing. Warm eye contact. Comfortable silence underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハンセン病史を研究されてるんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer researches the history of Hansen's disease.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. Slight pause before the second clause—respect for the weight of what they're saying. No judgment, just noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お城の要塞史を語ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi was telling us about the history of castle fortifications.
lines.style: Brighter, more engaged. Lean forward slightly. Energy in the voice—like she's remembered something that made her smile. Quick pace on the details.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のメニューに点字を加えたいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'd like to add braille to our menu, Mei.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not asking permission—thinking out loud with a friend. Soft but purposeful. Pause before the statement, like she's been turning it over.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、薬缶がもう沸騰してるって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer mentioned the kettle's already boiling.
lines.style: Quick, practical urgency. Bright and immediate—something that needs attention now. No drama, just noticing and telling. Light touch on the fact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、磁石のおもちゃに夢中ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That child is completely absorbed in the magnet toy.
lines.style: Warmth in the observation. Gentle smile underneath the words. Watching something small and genuine with fondness. Slow, tender pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の電気ワイヤーを新しくしたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We've upgraded the store's electrical wiring.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, but with quiet satisfaction. Not boasting—just stating something that took care and effort. Steady delivery, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スキー場のリフトのお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was telling me about ski lift mechanics.
lines.style: Reflective, pulling back slightly. Remembering something someone shared. Quiet and fond. Trailing tone—like there's more to the story but she's letting it rest.
